notes: Operator Rewards tracks on-chain ClaimedReward events from the reward pool, capturing all tokens reaching DePIN operators including those funded by the burn-credit-mint deflationary mints.

Ecosystem Rewards.methodology: 30% of supply vested linearly over 36 months from TGE, minus on-chain transfers from the Ecosystem Rewards wallet, the cold wallet, and the deployer into the operator reward pool. Those redirected tokens are emitted via the Operator Rewards section instead, so they aren't double-counted.

operator-rewards.name: Operator Rewards
operator-rewards.methodology: Tracks ClaimedReward events on the reward pool contract, these rewards are paid to DePIN Operators.
